display_long_description:
# Swing your racket to the beat!
I took the badminton mod from Beat Saber and turned it into a full rhythm game! Experience flow as you swing, smash, and return volleys to the beat of the music.

Get the full game here → https://vr.meta.me/s/1S5C9g6vEST6p3Q
[media]
[media]

# Work up a sweat!
Just 4 note types and 3 lanes combine to create complex patterns.
[media]
[media]

# 3 soundtracks to try out!
With 10+ in the full version!
[media]

# Audience reacts to your performance!
Watch the audience cheer in excitement during perfect swings.
[media]

# Aim for a Million!
Aim for a max score of 1,000,000 on each soundtrack to earn M rank.
[media]

# Discover artists with banger tracks!
From rhythm game artists like **t+pazolite** (Arcaea, DEEMO, & Cytus II) and **Nstryder** (osu!, Geometry Dash, & Sound Space).
[media]

Note: Progress does not carry over to full game.
